owner_decision_packet.question: Should the shallow-curved Solar Hull roof be represented as a new/derived layer above the two source-planar wing roof substrates, or should a new Watch Tower CAD revision replace/modify the source-planar top faces?

option_A.name: OVERLAY_ABOVE_SOURCE_SUBSTRATE
option_A.effect: Preserves the current FCStd planar roof geometry as structural/source substrate and adds a separately versioned curved Solar Hull/envelope geometry layer above it.

option_B.name: CAD_REVISION_REPLACES_OR_MODIFIES_SOURCE_FACE
option_B.effect: Creates a new authoritative Watch Tower CAD revision in which the wing roof geometry itself becomes curved; the current FCStd remains archived as superseded geometry evidence, not overwritten.
